title.zh: 将阿尔拜省 Tabaco、Tivi 与 Malinao 市镇 1903 年度土地税缴纳期限延至 1904 年 4 月 1 日，并规定退还已缴罚款的法案
title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF TABACO, TIVI, AND MALINAO, OF THE PROVINCE OF ALBAY, FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL APRIL FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF TABACO, TIVI, AND MALINAO, OF THE PROVINCE OF ALBAY, FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL APRIL FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất năm 1903 tại các thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Tabaco, Tivi và Malinao thuộc tỉnh Albay đến ngày 1 tháng 4 năm 1904 và quy định hoàn lại tiền phạt đã nộp
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติขยายระยะเวลาการชำระภาษีที่ดินปีค.ศ.1903ในเทศบาลทับาโก ทีวี และมาลินาโอ จังหวัดอัลบาย จนถึงวันที่1เมษายน พ.ศ.2447 และกำหนดให้คืนเงินปรับที่ได้ชำระไปแล้ว
title.id: Undang-Undang memperpanjang jangka waktu pembayaran pajak tanah tahun 1903 di Kotamadya Tabaco, Tivi, dan Malinao, Provinsi Albay hingga 1 April 1904 serta mengatur pengembalian denda yang telah dibayar
title.ms: Akta melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai tanah bagi tahun 1903 di Perbandaran Tabaco, Tivi, dan Malinao, Wilayah Albay sehingga 1 April 1904 dan menetapkan bayaran balik denda yang telah dibayar

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
three in the municipalities of Tabaeo, Tivi, and Malinao, of the Province of Albay, is hereby extended to
April first, nineteen hundred and four, anything in previous Acts to the contrary notwithstanding. All
penalties heretofore collected for the nonpayment of the land tax in the said municipalities for the year
nineteen hundred and three are hereby remitted, and the provincial treasurer of the province mentioned above
is authorized and directed to allow a rebate of the amount of such penalty, to the taxpayer upon whom the
penalty was assessed upon payment of his land tax for the year next ensuing.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Coin mission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 26, 1904.
